pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 70 degrees, relative humidity 59 percent, barometer 29.96 inches,
adjusted altitude 1,877 feet, track temperature 102 degrees.

Kalitta is third off the line and the power to chase them down for the win.  He has a big top end
speed.  Doug Kalitta's incremental times: 60ft-0.840 sec., 330ft-2.125, 660ft-2.980/297.81 mph. 
He sets the track speed record.  This is the third fastest pass in Top Fuel.
He wins first Wally this season and 60th of his career.
Langdon with the starting line advantage and the power to hold on for the hole shot win over Pruett
for the runner-up.
Pruett is straight down the groove for third place.
Stewart is second off the line, but up in smoke right at the hit and clicks it off.

Finish Order & Margins: 1. Doug Kalitta was 0.0146 sec./about 7 feet ahead of 2. Shawn Langdon, who
was 0.040 sec./about 19 feet ahead of 3. Leah Pruett, who was 6.901 sec./more than 100 feet ahead of
